next:or:508.hint: 偶然の出会いを表す句動詞
next:or:508.question: I [[ran onto]] an old friend yesterday.
next:or:508.fullSentence: I ran into an old friend yesterday.
next:or:508.explanation: run into ~『〜に偶然出会う/〜に衝突する』。
next:or:508.relatedInfo: come acrossも似た意味を持つ。

next:or:509.hint: 彼女はその知らせを聞いて急に泣き出した
next:or:509.fullSentence: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
next:or:509.explanation: burst into (tears)『急に〜し始める(泣き出す等)』。
next:or:509.relatedInfo: burst into laughter『急に笑い出す』も同じ形。

next:or:510.question: He [[divided the cake in]] eight pieces.
next:or:510.fullSentence: He divided the cake into eight pieces.
next:or:510.explanation: divide A into B『AをBに分ける』。
next:or:510.relatedInfo: intoは変化の結果を表す前置詞。

next:or:511.hint: 彼女は彼を説得してチームに入らせた
next:or:511.fullSentence: She talked him into joining the team.
next:or:511.explanation: talk A into B『Aを説得してBさせる』。
next:or:511.relatedInfo: talk A out of Bはその反対(説得してやめさせる)。

next:or:512.hint: 夢中になっていることを表す口語表現
next:or:512.question: She is really [[on]] yoga these days.
next:or:512.fullSentence: She is really into yoga these days.
next:or:512.relatedInfo: 口語的なカジュアル表現。

next:or:513.hint: 水は凍ると氷に変わる
next:or:513.fullSentence: Water changes into ice when it freezes.

next:or:514.question: The event will be held [[at Friday]].
next:or:514.fullSentence: The event will be held on Friday.
next:or:514.explanation: on Friday『金曜日に』。曜日にはonを使う。
next:or:514.relatedInfo: 時刻はat、月・年はinを使う。

next:or:515.hint: 彼らは午後を浜辺で過ごした
next:or:515.fullSentence: They spent the afternoon on the beach.
next:or:515.relatedInfo: 平面・接している場所を表すon。

next:or:516.hint: 燃焼中を表す前置詞句
next:or:516.question: The building is [[in fire]].
next:or:516.relatedInfo: set A on fire『Aに火をつける』もあわせて。

next:or:517.hint: 成功はどれだけ頑張るか次第だ
next:or:517.fullSentence: Success depends on how hard you work.
next:or:517.explanation: depend on / rely on『〜に頼る/〜次第である』。

next:or:518.hint: 不運が降りかかることを表す比喩表現
next:or:518.question: Bad luck seems to [[rain to me]].
next:or:518.fullSentence: Bad luck seems to rain on me.
next:or:518.explanation: rain on me『(悪いことが)私に降りかかる』。比喩的な用法。
next:or:518.relatedInfo: It never rains but it pours.(悪いことは重なる)とも関連。

next:or:519.hint: 彼女はダイエットを始めることにした
next:or:519.fullSentence: She decided to go on a diet.
next:or:519.explanation: go on a diet『ダイエットを始める』。
next:or:519.relatedInfo: be on a dietなら『ダイエット中』の状態を表す。

next:or:520.hint: メディアを表す前置詞
next:or:520.question: I saw the news [[in TV]].
next:or:520.fullSentence: I saw the news on TV.

next:or:521.hint: 今年、彼女の誕生日は日曜日に当たる
next:or:521.fullSentence: Her birthday falls on a Sunday this year.
next:or:521.relatedInfo: 曜日や日付が一致することを表す。

next:or:522.hint: 逆さまの状態を表す慣用句
next:or:522.question: The child can [[stand in its head]].
next:or:522.fullSentence: The child can stand on its head.
next:or:522.explanation: stand on its head『逆立ちする』。
next:or:522.relatedInfo: headを軸にして立つイメージ。

next:or:523.hint: 電話が突然私のところで不通になった
next:or:523.fullSentence: The phone suddenly went dead on me.
next:or:523.explanation: go dead on (someone)『(電話などが)不通になる』。
next:or:523.relatedInfo: onには『(その人にとって)不都合な形で』というニュアンスがある。

next:or:524.question: The town is [[at the Thames River]].
next:or:524.fullSentence: The town is on the Thames River.
next:or:524.relatedInfo: 接している位置関係を表すon。

next:or:525.hint: 子供たちは一日中日なたに出ていた
next:or:525.fullSentence: The children were out in the sun all day.
next:or:525.explanation: be out in the sun『日なたに出ている』。
next:or:525.relatedInfo: inは光や空間に包まれているイメージ。

next:or:526.hint: 情報を与えない状態を表す慣用句
next:or:526.question: They [[kept her in dark]] about the plan.
next:or:526.fullSentence: They kept her in the dark about the plan.
next:or:526.explanation: keep ~ in the dark『〜に知らせないでおく』。
next:or:526.relatedInfo: 『暗闇の中に置く』が転じて情報を与えない意味に。

next:or:527.hint: 彼女は彼が真の友人だと気づいた
next:or:527.fullSentence: She has found a true friend in him.
next:or:527.explanation: have found a friend in A『Aが友人だと気づいた/Aに友人を見出した』。
next:or:527.relatedInfo: inは『〜の中に(その資質を)見出す』イメージ。

next:or:528.hint: 進行を妨げることを表す慣用句
next:or:528.question: Nothing will [[stand on my way]].
next:or:528.fullSentence: Nothing will stand in my way.
next:or:528.explanation: stand in one's way『〜の邪魔をする』。
next:or:528.relatedInfo: 『道の中に立ちはだかる』が転じた表現。

next:or:529.hint: 周辺・あたりを表す前置詞
next:or:529.question: Magazines were scattered [[under]] the book.
next:or:529.fullSentence: Magazines were scattered about the book.
next:or:529.explanation: about『〜の周り、あたりにあるもの』。
next:or:529.relatedInfo: aroundとほぼ同じ意味で使われる。

next:or:530.hint: 彼らは放課後モールでぶらぶらしている
next:or:530.fullSentence: They just hang around at the mall after school.
next:or:530.relatedInfo: 目的なく時間を過ごすことを表す。

next:or:531.hint: 他人の事情を嗅ぎ回ることを表す句動詞
next:or:531.question: He is always [[nosing at]] in other people's business.
next:or:531.fullSentence: He is always nosing around in other people's business.
next:or:531.explanation: nose around『詮索する、嗅ぎ回る』。
next:or:531.relatedInfo: noseが動詞として使われる珍しい例。

next:or:532.hint: コンサートにはおよそ100人いた(約)
next:or:532.fullSentence: There were about a hundred people at the concert.
next:or:532.explanation: A about B『AはおよそB』(数量的に「約」)。
next:or:532.relatedInfo: approximatelyよりカジュアルな言い方。
